claims.text: There has to be a way to keep these people safe even if it means compromising on some norms.
The lack of control over how people think is unfair.

implicit_assumptions: A1: Implementing a compromise will reduce additional verbal and physical attacks.
decomposition.reasoning_relation: C1 is supported by the premise that neglecting compromise would lead to more attacks; the claim that control over thoughts is unfair is meant to justify the need for compromise.
scope_notes: the argument applies to the current political climate in Costa Rica, where safety concerns over LGBTQI rights are rising
uncertainty: the effectiveness of the proposed compromise is uncertain; the comment does not specify the form of compromise or how it would reduce attacks
